mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5% and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in a month and the S&P 500 still produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines by more than 10% YoY and the S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 2% MoM and the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day returns in more than 45% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day returns in more than 45% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and the S&P 500 still produces negative 5-day returns in more than 45% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth slows below 1% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4%, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY growth is below 1% and UNRATE is above 4%, but the S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, when the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 3% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) growth is above 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is above 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth is above 2%, but the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of the triggered instances.
